doc.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997

title: Eighty-five dollars a week was big money
summary: He says the pay was enough to support his family and send money home.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: So eighty-five dollars a week you were getting. Was that enough to live on and send some home to support your son?
Oh, yeah, oh sure. © Fillius Jazz Archive -13-
Oh that was big money. Gee if you got the hundred dollars, you know a dollar was a dollar then. So that fifteen dollars, to get to a hundred, wow.
